events.summary:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures in the upper 20s to lower 30s
expected.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast Georgia and southeast South Carolina.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM EST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...In addition to freezing temperatures,
widespread frost is likely.

* IMPACTS...Gale force winds and high seas will result in

damaged vessels.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Gale force winds may arrive earlier if the
front continues to trend faster.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Comanche, OK; Cotton, OK; Tillman, OK
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Comanche County in southwestern Oklahoma...
Central Cotton County in southwestern Oklahoma...
Southeastern Tillman County in southwestern Oklahoma...

* WHEN...Until 300 AM CST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1158 PM CST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Lawton, Walters, Geronimo, Grandfield, Chattanooga, Randlett,
Devol, Faxon, Loveland, Cookietown, southeastern Fort Sill and
Hulen.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...The National Weather Service in Seattle has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Washington...

Skokomish River At Potlatch affecting Mason County.

.Heavy rain along the south slopes of the Olympics overnight will
push the Skokomish River above flood stage Sunday morning.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Skokomish River at Potlatch.

* WHEN...From late tonight to Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 16.5 feet, the Skokomish River will cause widespread
flooding of pasture lands, with water flowing quickly over West
Bourgault Road and Skokomish Valley Road.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 PM PST Saturday the stage was 16.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
tonight to a crest of 17.1 feet late Sunday morning. It will then
fall below flood stage early Monday morning.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.region: Aransas Islands; Kleberg Islands; Nueces Islands; Calhoun Islands
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Aransas Islands, Kleberg Islands, Nueces Islands and
Calhoun Islands Counties.

* WHEN...From Sunday evening through Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the most experienced
swimmers away from shore into deeper water. These rip currents
can become life-threatening to anyone entering the surf.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor coastal flooding is also possible,
especially late tonight into early Monday morning.
